name: Lab rules
description: House rules for experiments and samples: a check before a save, a summary and search entry after one, and a second pair of eyes when an experiment goes to review.
author: Acme Bio

record-hooks.title: Experiments need a clear title and a protocol note
record-hooks.description: Refuses an experiment whose title is too short, warns when it has no protocol note, and fills in the default storage tag.

record-hooks.title: Summarise and index experiments
record-hooks.description: Writes a one-line summary on the record and adds it to the plugin's search index so it can be found by meaning.

record-hooks.title: A second pair of eyes before review
record-hooks.description: When an experiment goes to review, asks a reviewer other than the person who sent it to sign off, and clears the hold once they have.

record-hooks.title: Refuse empty uploads
record-hooks.description: Stops a file with no content from being uploaded.

search-providers.title: Similar experiments
search-providers.description: Finds experiments whose summary matches the words typed, using the index the summarise hook builds.
